queries_run: United Therapeutics product substitute technology threat 2026 PAH sotatercept Winrevair competition Tyvaso

findings.claim: 10-K 披露：公司在再生醫學（Miromatrix、IVIVA）開發人造肝、腎替代產品；miroliverELAP 一期達主要終點，Miromatrix 規劃二期。屬公司自家的新技術布局（非外部替代威脅）。
findings.excerpt: In January 2026 we announced that Miromatrix completed a phase 1 study of miroliverELAP in patients with acute liver failure. This study, which was the first human clinical trial of a manufactured organ alternative, met its primary endpoint. Miromatrix is planning to commence a phase 2 study.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：付款方可能要求自動學名藥替代或階梯療法（先試學名藥），使公司產品較難取得給付。
findings.excerpt: require the automatic substitution of generic products, demand more rigorous requirements for initial coverage for new products, implement step therapy policies that require patients to try other medicines, including generic products, before using our products

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋摘要顯示 Winrevair（Merck）、Yutrepia（Liquidia）已競爭 treprostinil 產品、Insmed TPIP 為後期候選，但未取得可逐字複製原文，僅列 clues。

clues.claim: 10-Q（截至2026-09-30）稱 Winrevair、Yutrepia 等競品已影響 treprostinil 銷售；Insmed TPIP 為後期候選
